chunks: We dispersed them in groups over the earth, some righteous, some otherwise; and We tried them with good things and bad, that they may haply turn back.
ai.seo_question: How did God test the Israelites according to Surah Al-A'raf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine wisdom behind the fragmentation of the Children of Israel into distinct tribes, a division that facilitated both their governance and their eventual testing. The dual trials of 'al-hasanat' (often interpreted as prosperity and ease) and 'al-sayyi'at' (adversity and hardship) serve as a mechanism for spiritual refinement, urging them to return to monotheism. This narrative underscores the Shia understanding of history as a deliberate arena for moral choice and divine mercy.
